# Ezeebit

> Ezeebit is stablecoin and crypto payment infrastructure for merchants across Africa. It lets merchants accept stablecoin and cryptocurrency payments in-store and online. It is not a retail cryptocurrency exchange, and it is not an Australian exchange.

Ezeebit (Ezee Solutions Group (Pty) Ltd) builds the checkout, conversion and settlement layer. A customer pays from a crypto wallet. The merchant can be settled in a stablecoin (USDT or USDC) or in ZAR, KES, NGN or USD. The company is based in Cape Town, South Africa. South Africa is the live market. Kenya and Nigeria are the next markets.

Ezeebit is regulated by South Africa's Financial Sector Conduct Authority (FSCA).

Ezeebit does not offer retail crypto trading and this site does not give investment advice.

## Products

- **In-store ePOS** — an Android point of sale for physical stores, plus ezeebit Pay static QR. <https://ezeebit.com/in-store>
- **Online payments** — plugins for Shopify, WooCommerce and Magento, and hosted checkout. <https://ezeebit.com/online>
- **Platforms** — crypto pay-ins and stablecoin payouts for gaming, trading, wallet and payment platforms. <https://ezeebit.com/platforms>
- **Payouts** — pay customers from an Ezeebit balance in USDT or other crypto. Recipients choose the asset and network. <https://ezeebit.com/payouts>
- **Wallets** — hold fiat and USDT, convert between them, fund payouts, and withdraw to a bank or a wallet. <https://ezeebit.com/wallets>
- **Developer API** — signed REST endpoints for payments, payouts and wallets, with webhooks. <https://ezeebit.com/developers>
- **Pricing** — 1% per successful transaction, excluding VAT, or lower depending on volume. No setup fee on the Starter plan. <https://ezeebit.com/pricing>
- **OTC desk** — large crypto-to-fiat trades quoted by a dealer, settled in ZAR, KES, NGN or USD. <https://ezeebit.com/otc>

## Who it is for

Chief operating officers, chief financial officers and heads of payments at multi-store retailers. Heads of product at e-commerce, iGaming and payment platforms.

## How a payment works

1. The customer pays in-store (ePOS or static QR) or online (plugin or checkout).
2. Ezeebit converts the payment at the rate locked at checkout, so the merchant does not hold a volatile asset.
3. The merchant is settled in USDT or USDC, or in ZAR, KES, NGN or USD.

Supported assets include BTC, ETH, USDT, USDC, BNB, DAI and PAXG, on Bitcoin, Ethereum, TRON, BNB Smart Chain and Solana. Customers can pay from a wallet, including via WalletConnect, or from Luno, VALR or Binance where those connections are switched on.

## Markets

- South Africa is live, with settlement in ZAR.
- Kenya and Nigeria are the next markets, with settlement in KES and NGN.
